script.title: CHECKING IN AT SEVEN
script.scene_zh: 飯店大廳 · 提早入住
script.story_hook: A red-eye flight lands way too early for check-in.
script.intro_zh: 紅眼班機到得太早，還沒到入住時間。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the hotel lobby this morning. Today's quest: an early check-in.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今早的飯店大廳，今天的任務是：提早入住。
script.outro: Rooms aren't always ready, but good words help. Repeat after us. Safe travels!
script.outro_zh: 房間不一定準備好，但好話能幫忙。一起跟讀吧！
script.practice_intro_en: Now, let's say every line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，每一句我們都一起說一次。
script.char_a_description: a sleepy young man in his late twenties, tousled light brown hair, thin stubble, wrinkled gray blazer over a plain tee, rolling carry-on bag at his side, average build, dark circles under his eyes
script.char_b_description: a warm woman in her mid thirties, chestnut hair in a low bun, pearl earrings, cream cardigan over a collared shirt with a key charm, average build, bright welcoming eyes, gentle smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, we just landed from Chicago.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我們剛從芝加哥落地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! That's a red-eye, right?
dialogue.zh: 歡迎！那是紅眼班機吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six in the morning. Somehow, awake.
dialogue.zh: 清晨六點，不知怎麼還醒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, rough. Booking under what name?
dialogue.zh: 真辛苦，請問訂房用什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noah and Priya. One room, lake view.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊə ænd ˈpɹi.jə wʌn ɹum leɪk vju/
dialogue.zh: 諾亞跟普里雅，一間湖景房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Priya? Also my name, small world.
dialogue.zh: 普里雅？我也叫這個名字，世界真小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That's a good sign.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？這算是好兆頭吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, you're here at seven sharp.
dialogue.zh: 所以你們七點整就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a problem? We can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə ˈpɹɑbləm wi kæn weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這樣不行嗎？我們願意等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check-in starts at three, officially.
dialogue.zh: 正式入住是下午三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three? But it's seven now.
dialogue.zh: 三點？可現在才早上七點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, honey. Rooms aren't clean yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈnoʊ ˈhʌni ɹʊmz ˈɑɹənt klin jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 我知道，親，房間還沒整理好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the wait, roughly?
dialogue.zh: 大概要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most are ready by eleven thirty.
dialogue.zh: 大部分房間十一點半前會整理好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Can we leave bags here first?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ kæn wi liv bæɡz hɪɹ fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 好，可以先在這裡放行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a luggage room, no charge.
dialogue.zh: 可以，有行李室，不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're amazing. Just two small bags.
dialogue.zh: 你太好了，我們就兩個小包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easier than a wedding order, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiːziɚ ðæn ə ˈwɛdɪŋ ˈɔɹdɚ tɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 比婚宴訂單好處理多了，信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Is there a wedding here this week?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈwɛdɪŋ hɪɹ ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這週這裡有婚禮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lakeview Lodge books fast in June.
dialogue.zh: 湖景旅館六月很快就訂滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We almost missed it, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，我們差點訂不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad you're here. A cancellation just came in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd jɚ hɪɹ ə kæn.səˈleɪʃən dʒʌst keɪm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 很高興你們來了，有人剛取消一間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No way. Can we take it early?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ kæn wi teɪk ɪt ˈɜɹli/
dialogue.zh: 不是吧，我們可以早點住進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's small, and needs ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 那間很小，還得再整理十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't care about size. Shower.
dialogue.zh: 我不挑大小，只要有熱水澡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That attitude gets you far here.
dialogue.zh: 這種心態在我們這裡最吃香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. What's the room number?
dialogue.zh: 太願意了，幾號房？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nineteen two, fourth floor, quiet side.
dialogue.zh: 一九二，四樓，安靜那一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds perfect. Can I add one thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ˈpɜɹfɪkt kæn aɪ æd wʌn θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來完美，我能再多問一件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we're off to a good start.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wɪɹ ɔˈf tu ə ɡʊd stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我們開頭很順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you text me when it's ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju tɛkst mi wɛn ɪts ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 可以準備好時傳訊息給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, same number as your booking?
dialogue.zh: 好啊，電話跟你訂房時的一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that cell works for texts.
dialogue.zh: 對，那支手機可以收簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. I'll ping you when it's clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt aɪl pɪŋ ju wɛn ɪts klin/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，整理好我就通知你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're official magic, you know that?
dialogue.zh: 你簡直是魔法師，你知道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flattery before three is standard here.
dialogue.zh: 三點前的誇獎，我們都照收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, fair. Where's the coffee, then?
dialogue.zh: 哈，算你說得對。那咖啡在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, open from six, free.
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，六點開，免費喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free coffee may fix the whole day.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈkɔːfi meɪ fɪks ðə hoʊl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 免費咖啡可能救回這一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has revived many tired guests.
dialogue.zh: 它救回過好多累壞的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll be one of them, gladly.
dialogue.zh: 我願意當其中一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two sugars? We keep them stocked.
dialogue.zh: 兩包糖嗎？我們備得很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, thanks. Um, the spa hours?
dialogue.zh: 一包就好，謝謝。呃，水療幾點開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From ten until eight, closed for lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹəm tɛn ʌnˈtɪl eɪt kloʊzd fɔɹ lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 十點開到八點，午休時間不開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. After my shower nap, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 挺好，等我洗完澡小睡一場再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've got it all figured out.
dialogue.zh: 你全都想好啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually, one tiny favor, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 其實還有個小請求，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask, it's still early for me.
dialogue.zh: 你問吧，我今天的時間還早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is our luggage safe back there?
dialogue.zh: 我們的行李放後面那間安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locked room, one key, I'm it.
dialogue.zh: 倉庫會上鎖，鑰匙只在我身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. So checkout stays at noon?
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那退房還是中午十二點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, noon, wedding or no wedding.
dialogue.zh: 對，十二點，有婚禮也一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we'll test that kindness.
dialogue.zh: 說不定我們真會試試這份好心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, I might actually allow it.
dialogue.zh: 小心說，我可能真的會答應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Priya, I think we'll come back once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹi.jə aɪ θɪŋk wil kʌm bæk wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 普里雅，我想我們會再來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll save the lake view next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl seɪv ðə leɪk vju nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 那我下次幫你們留湖景房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one, but with a real bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn bʊt wɪð ə ɹiːl bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 一次就好，但要有真正的床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nineteen two has the best one.
dialogue.zh: 一九二就有最好的一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'm officially in love already.
dialogue.zh: 那我已經正式愛上這間飯店了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save some love for breakfast, okay?
dialogue.zh: 留一點胃口給早餐，好嗎？

script.youtube_title_en: You're Official Magic - Asking for Early Check-In at a Hotel
script.youtube_description:
「You're official magic!」紅眼班機早上七點抵達，還沒到入住時間，該怎麼辦？這一集 60 句美式英文對話：從詢問入住、寄存行李，到剛好有人取消訂房，早到的客人也有了床位。

你會聽到：
- 說明入住規定（Check-in starts at three, officially.）
- 寄存行李（Can we leave bags here first? / a luggage room, no charge.）
- 請對方傳訊通知（Could you text me when it's ready?）

這一集帶大家走進湖景旅館的櫃台：諾亞只想早點沖澡，櫃檯普里雅想盡辦法幫忙。
